EXAMPLES_INTRO: Three examples with the exact English voices and illustrations included in the device's microSD bundle.
TAROT_BODY: Type a question in Tarot / AI. The oracle draws three different major arcana—past, present and future—and asks LiteLLM for a playful reading in English. This mode needs Wi-Fi and your own proxy key. Narration is available for the pre-generated fortunes; online Tarot is text and a printable receipt.
HOW_TITLE:
A little AI.
Plenty of prepared destiny.
STEPS: Left and right change decks. Other keys on the home screen start a fortune.
A short animation and magical sounds synthesized on the device. Each theme has its own queue without repeats until exhausted.
Only the selected card is loaded from SD. A picture appears, followed by scrolling text. The narration is recorded in advance with ElevenLabs.
One automatic Bluetooth print attempt on a BQ95. Press P for another copy of the same fortune.

BUILD_TITLE:
The deck, the voice
and the code.
BUILD_INTRO: You'll need a Cardputer ADV, FAT32 microSD and M5Apps. Text, WAV recordings, artwork and receipts are included. No need to regenerate content or supply a key for offline fortunes.
BUILD_STATUS: English is the default build. Russian and Simplified Chinese bundles are also available. Software checks pass; check installation, sound and wireless functions on your own device.
INSTALL_COPY: Install through M5Apps → Installer → SD. Copy the BIN and the complete ORACLE folder from the same English ZIP to the microSD root. The source sdcard/ directory is not the English release pack.
INSTALL_LAUNCHER: If M5Apps is not installed, set it up over USB with a data cable first. Later Oracle updates only need a card reader. The header should show SD; DEMO means the complete deck was not loaded.
INSTALL_PRIVATE: Preserve your private ORACLE/config.json when updating. Files inside ORACLE/print/ and ORACLE/fonts/ are resources, not installable firmware. The guide covers the directory layout, Wi-Fi, updates and troubleshooting.
